title: JUKI MO-6816D
subtitle: High-Speed 2-Needle, 4-Thread Safety-Stitch / Interlock Machine (MO-6800D Series)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The JUKI MO-6816D is a high-speed, 2-needle, 4-thread safety-stitch / interlock machine belonging to the JUKI MO-6800D series. It performs seaming, edge-trimming, and overedging in a single pass, with a 3 mm or 5 mm needle width. It is a direct-drive head (combined with an integrated AC servo motor / control box) used for general apparel seaming on medium to heavy-weight woven and knit fabrics.
applications: Seaming and overedging medium to heavy-weight woven fabrics in a single pass
Seaming and overedging knit fabrics (T-shirts, polo shirts, sportswear, underwear)
General apparel seaming requiring safety-stitch (504 / 514 / 516 type) construction
Edge trimming and overedging operations where the upper and lower knives are required
Production lines requiring consistent stitch quality at high speed (up to 7,000 sti/min)
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing (woven and knit), underwear and sportswear production, uniform manufacturing, light industrial textile assembly

overviewDescription: The JUKI MO-6816D is the 2-needle / 4-thread safety-stitch variant of the JUKI MO-6800D overlock series. It uses two needles, an upper looper, and a lower looper to form a 4-thread safety stitch while simultaneously edge-trimming the fabric with a fixed lower knife and a moving upper knife. The machine is built around a sealed lower-loop lubrication system (the needle bar and upper looper are oil-free), a 24.5 mm needle bar stroke, lever-type differential feed adjustment with micro-adjust, and a push-button stitch-length selector. The MO-6816D is offered in head-only form for direct-drive mounting on the JUKI PM-6810 / equivalent smart control box with an integrated AC servo motor.

technicalSpecs.value: Automatic; needle bar and upper looper are oil-free

workingPrinciples.heading: 1. Two-Needle, Four-Thread Safety Stitch Formation
workingPrinciples.description: Two needles carry the upper needle threads through the fabric. The lower looper carries the lower looper thread and interlocks with both needle threads below the needle plate. The upper looper carries the upper looper thread and forms a cross-over stitch on top of the fabric. The result is a 516-type safety stitch with 4 threads total, providing a stretchable, durable seam with a finished edge in a single pass.

workingPrinciples.heading: 2. Upper and Lower Knife Edge-Trimming
workingPrinciples.description: A fixed lower knife and a moving upper knife trim the fabric edge to a consistent width just before the needles enter the fabric. The upper knife is driven by a separate knife-drive linkage from the main shaft, allowing precise synchronization with the stitch cycle and adjustable cutting width.

workingPrinciples.heading: 3. Differential Feed Mechanism
workingPrinciples.description: The differential feed has a main feed dog (front) and a differential feed dog (rear), driven by independent feed eccentrics. The differential ratio is set with a lever (with micro-adjust), allowing gathering (1:2, max 1:4) for stretch fabrics or stretching (1:0.7, max 1:0.6) for slippery knits. This prevents seam distortion and produces flat, stretchable seams on knit fabrics.

workingPrinciples.heading: 4. Direct-Drive AC Servo Motor
workingPrinciples.description: The MO-6816D head is designed for direct mounting on a JUKI PM-6810 (or equivalent) smart control box with an integrated AC servo motor. The motor drives the main shaft directly via a coupling, eliminating the V-belt and clutch of conventional mounting. This provides instant start/stop, precise speed control via the pedal, and low noise / low vibration operation.

workingPrinciples.heading: 5. Active Thread Tension System
workingPrinciples.description: Each of the four threads (two needle threads, upper looper thread, lower looper thread) passes through an individual thread tension assembly with disc tension, thread take-up spring, and tension release pin. The tensions are set independently and adjusted for fabric type and stitch width.

workingPrinciples.heading: 6. Sealed Lower-Loop Automatic Lubrication
workingPrinciples.description: The lower loop (main shaft, feed mechanism, lower looper, hook area) is enclosed and lubricated by an automatic forced-circulation system using a worm pump driven off the main shaft. The upper looper and needle bar mechanism are oil-free, eliminating the risk of oil staining on light-colored fabrics.

workingPrinciples.heading: 7. Push-Button Stitch Length Adjustment
workingPrinciples.description: Stitch length is set by a push-button selector on the front of the machine. The selector engages a different feed-eccentric position, changing the feed dog stroke per stitch. This eliminates the need to open the machine and manually swap feed eccentrics for different stitch lengths.

sequenceFlow.stepDescription: Control box / pedal powered; needle position sensor initialized
Thread needle-L → needle-R → upper looper → lower looper per threading diagram
Adjust four individual thread tension assemblies
Lever + micro-adjust set to fabric (gather / neutral / stretch)
Push-button selector set to required length
Verify oil reservoir level; check oil flow at sight glass
Lay fabric under presser foot, align edge with lower knife
Presser foot lifts, machine starts at set speed
Needles / loopers / knives / feed dogs in synchronized motion
Manual scissors or chain cutter separates chain at end of seam
Needle stops in up position; presser foot lifts
Check stitch balance, tension, edge trimming quality
Wipe down, re-thread, refill oil, log production

partsList.function: Applies a trace of silicone oil to the needle thread as it passes through, reducing needle heat and thread friction. Standard equipment on the MO-6800D series.

maintenance.definition: Wrong needle size, needle bar height out of adjustment, needle clamp loose, fabric obstruction, or stitch timing off
maintenance.action: Replace needle with correct DC×27 size, check needle bar height (24.5 mm stroke, 20° angle), tighten needle clamp screw, verify looper timing, clear any obstruction

maintenance.definition: Tension too high, needle thread cooler empty, needle thread path obstructed, needle eye / point rough, or machine running too fast for the thread type
maintenance.action: Reduce needle thread tension, refill needle thread cooler with silicone oil, clean thread path, replace needle, reduce speed for fine thread

maintenance.definition: Tension too high, looper thread path obstructed, looper point / eye damaged, looper timing off, or looper needle-plate clearance incorrect
maintenance.action: Reduce looper tension, clean looper thread path, inspect / replace looper, re-time looper per manual, adjust looper-to-needle clearance

maintenance.definition: Needle / looper timing off, needle bar height wrong, needle clamp loose, looper point worn, or needle / thread mismatch
maintenance.action: Re-time needle to looper per manual, reset needle bar height, tighten needle clamp, replace looper if worn, verify needle size and thread size

maintenance.definition: Knives dull or chipped, knife timing off, knife pressure spring weak, or knife alignment off
maintenance.action: Sharpen or replace upper / lower knife, adjust knife timing, replace knife pressure spring, re-align upper / lower knife

maintenance.definition: Differential lever / micro-adjust set wrong for fabric, feed dog teeth worn, feed dog height wrong, or feed dog spring weak
maintenance.action: Re-set differential lever to gather / neutral / stretch as needed, inspect feed dog teeth, adjust feed dog height, replace feed dog springs

maintenance.code: No Oil Flow at Sight Glass
maintenance.definition: Oil reservoir empty, oil filter clogged, oil pump worm worn, or oil distribution line blocked
maintenance.action: Refill with JUKI MACHINE OIL 18, clean or replace oil filter, inspect / replace oil pump worm, flush oil distribution lines

maintenance.definition: Oil seal / gasket worn, oil reservoir overfilled, oil return line blocked, or head cover seal damaged
maintenance.action: Replace worn oil seals, drain to correct level, clear oil return line, replace damaged cover gaskets

maintenance.definition: Power supply issue, control box fault, foot pedal failure, synchronizer failure, or motor error code
maintenance.action: Check power supply, check control box for error codes, test foot pedal, test synchronizer, refer to PM-6810 error code table

maintenance.code: Needle Does Not Stop in Up Position
maintenance.definition: Synchronizer misalignment, synchronizer failure, or control box error
maintenance.action: Re-align synchronizer per manual, replace synchronizer if faulty, clear control box error or replace control box

maintenance.definition: Loose mounting bolts, worn bearing or bushing, oil starvation, or main-shaft coupling worn
maintenance.action: Tighten head mounting bolts, replace worn bearing / bushing, refill oil, replace main-shaft coupling

maintenance.definition: Push-button selector worn, stitch selector cam set not engaging, or feed eccentric linkage loose
maintenance.action: Replace push-button selector, inspect / replace cam set, re-tighten feed eccentric linkage

finalNotes:
• The JUKI MO-6816D is one model in the MO-6800D series (alongside MO-6804D 1-needle, MO-6814D 2-needle overlock, MO-6843D 3-needle interlock). It is the 2-needle / 4-thread safety-stitch (516 type) variant with a 3 mm or 5 mm needle width.
• Per the official JUKI product page, common specifications across the MO-6800D series are: max 7,000 sti/min, 0.6–3.8 mm (max 4.5 mm) stitch length, 24.5 mm needle bar stroke, 20° needle inclination angle, lower-bushing needle bar guide, DC×27 needle system, 7 mm max presser foot lift, 63.7 N max presser foot pressure, lever-type differential feed with micro-adjust, push-button stitch length selector, automatic lower-loop lubrication (needle bar and upper looper are oil-free), JUKI MACHINE OIL 18, 27 kg head weight, standard needle point and thread coolers, and an optional micro-lifter.
• The MO-6816D head is offered as a direct-drive head for mounting on the JUKI PM-6810 (or equivalent) smart control box with integrated AC servo motor. Motor specifications are not listed on the product page.
• All 4 threads (needle-L, needle-R, upper looper, lower looper) require independent tension adjustment and a corresponding thread take-up spring.
• Verified flag is ⚠️ (1 official source = JUKI product page) for every part in this document. When the official JUKI parts catalog is accessed via the WebPartsList portal and the instruction manual PDF is parsed, parts can be upgraded to ✅ (2+ official sources).
• The instruction manual and parts catalog PDFs on juki.co.jp are in Japanese only. An English version of the manual could not be located on the public JUKI site as of 2026-06-16.
